created_for: First full pair screening after the 2026-11-10 pilot date passed
main_method: timetable-based journeys remain the intended main method; this batch collects direct services only
scope: 32 core cities (31 mainland provincial capitals/municipalities plus Hong Kong), 992 directed query pairs; 3 auxiliary access probes
anchor_rule: Query anchor only; record actual returned stations. A single anchor request is not proof of complete multi-station coverage; later audit must assess omitted candidates.
station_set_rule: Use candidate stations from the saved stage1B v2 draft for provisional summaries; return unexpected stations separately for review, never silently merge or discard them.
empty_result_policy: successful empty direct-query result, not physical unreachability
macau_policy: keep Macau node; investigate auxiliary Zhuhai/Hengqin links separately; no unverified access times
taiwan_policy: keep Taipei node; no 12306 query; do not fill penalty until source and matrix review
matrix_policy: export directed direct-service diagnostic table with explicit statuses; not algorithm-ready, no shortest-route claims, no penalties or imputation
new_date_policy: Do not mix with the 2026-11-10 pilot; never silently change dates
limits: Only passenger services returned by the official website at recorded access times. Public website availability is not bulk-use authorization or completeness assurance. Stop on access restrictions and unexpected responses.
